title: Price and Volume Effects Associated with Changes in the S&P 500 List
one_line: S&P 500 additions rise ~3% right after the announcement with heavy volume, and the gain reverses within about two weeks — temporary price pressure from index funds.

findings.statement: ~+3% immediate increase, fully reversed after ~2 weeks (1978-1983).
